causes.quote: At 2.47 pm there was an unplanned outage of the Lower Tumut to Wagga 330 kV line which was caused by bushfires in the area.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: The effect of these constraints, which were in place from the 3.05 pm dispatch interval, saw the flows on the Vic-NSW interconnector reverse from imports in to Victoria to forced exports in to New South Wales. This was around a 570 MW change.

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: High temperatures in Melbourne led to high demand in Victoria. The temperature exceeded 40°C in Melbourne and demand reached 8204 MW at 3.30 pm.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: On the day there was two large generators offline in Victoria, AGL's Loy Yang A2 (530 MW) and Alinta Energy's Loy Yang B1 (490 MW). The A2 unit had been offline since 27 December due to a plant failure while the B1 unit had been offline since 29 December due to a tube leak.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: Generator availability was around 100 MW lower than forecast due to plant issues at Macarthur wind farm
